d <- read.csv("/app/data.csv"); y <- d$y; n <- d$n
ll <- function(p) { a <- exp(p[1]); b <- exp(p[2])
  sum(lbeta(y + a, b + n - y) - lbeta(a, b) - lchoose(n, y)) }
opt <- optim(c(0.5, 2.0), function(p) -ll(p), hessian = TRUE)
a <- exp(opt$par[1]); b <- exp(opt$par[2])
cat("MLE: alpha =", a, " beta =", b, " alpha+beta =", a+b, "\n")
cat("loglik =", opt$value * -1, "\n")
'
